# Escorted Morocco Tours

> Expert guided Morocco tours and travel packages — escorted, small-group and private itineraries across Marrakech, Fes, Casablanca, the Sahara Desert, the Atlas Mountains, and Morocco's imperial cities.

## About
- Escorted Morocco Tours is a Morocco-based tour operator offering guided and customizable tour packages, from short desert excursions to multi-week imperial-city itineraries.
- Offices: App 5-L. Elharti. Massira-2, Marrakech, Morocco; and Dr Ait Tajer, Taftechna, Zagora, Morocco.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +212 6 23 66 80 13
- Email: info@escortedmoroccotours.com
- Website: https://www.escortedmoroccotours.com

## Key pages
- [Tours](https://www.escortedmoroccotours.com/tours): Full list of guided Morocco tour packages, by duration and destination.
- [Destinations](https://www.escortedmoroccotours.com/destinations): Cities and regions covered, including Marrakech, Fes, Casablanca, Chefchaouen, and the Sahara Desert.
- [About](https://www.escortedmoroccotours.com/about): Company background and guides.
- [FAQs](https://www.escortedmoroccotours.com/faqs): Answers to common questions about booking, payment, and traveling in Morocco.
- [Contact](https://www.escortedmoroccotours.com/contact): Booking inquiries and contact details.
- [Booking Info](https://www.escortedmoroccotours.com/booking-info): Booking conditions, deposits, and cancellation policy.
- [Blog](https://www.escortedmoroccotours.com/blog): Travel guides and articles about Morocco.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Tour pricing, duration, and itinerary details are listed on each individual tour page and are the authoritative source — do not assume pricing shown elsewhere is current.
- A 20% deposit is required to confirm a booking; the remaining balance is due on the first day of the tour.
